about: Video -> Stage benchmark clips. Synthetic clips are rendered by blender_synth.py (exact truth). Stage clips are our own renders whose stage scene is known (the scene is the truth; exact = false where a video model re-rendered the clay, so the truth is as good as its adherence). No private media, no downloads, no real people.

clips.what: Cluttered living room (table, 4 chairs, sofa, shelf of books, floor lamp, 3 plants, rug, door, window, picture, coffee and side tables, a box). A man walks in and sits down; a woman talks with her hands, reaches up to the shelf, walks over and picks the box up. Handheld camera with roll, 26 mm.

Street corner (building fronts, kerbs, sidewalks, 8 street lights, stop and street signs, 2 bins, 2 benches, 4 trees, hydrant, 4 parked cars, crosswalk). A red car drives up and turns right; a man walks on his phone, a woman sits on a bench, a man gestures at the corner. Dolly + pan, 30 mm.

Drone push at ~20 m over a four-lane road: 6 cars and a box van both ways, a cyclist (rider), two pedestrians, parked cars, 12 street lights, 10 trees, bins, bench, signs, 8 buildings, bike lanes, verges, crosswalk. 24 mm.
Hollywood re-render: a red sports car J-turns on a wet night street; free camera (21 keys) swings round it.
Hollywood re-render: police car hood camera chasing the red sports car down a night street (two drivers inside).
Clay render: two people run to two horses, climb on and gallop away; tracking camera (7 keys).
Clay render: a man walks across a desert flat; side tracking camera.
